en.headline: Customs seize 3kg of cannabis buds from Bangkok arrival at airport
en.dek: A 56-year-old mainland man was arrested after officers found the suspected cannabis and other items in his carry-on baggage.
body: Hong Kong Customs arrested a 56-year-old mainland male passenger at Hong Kong International Airport on Monday after seizing about 3 kilogrammes of suspected cannabis buds with an estimated market value of about HK$600,000.

The man arrived from Bangkok. During customs clearance, officers found the suspected cannabis buds, a product containing suspected Part 1 poison, and seven duty-not-paid cigarettes in his carry-on baggage.
The investigation is ongoing. Customs reminded the public that drug trafficking carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and life imprisonment.

zh.headline: 海關機場截查曼谷抵港旅客 檢約3公斤大麻花
zh.dek: 一名56歲內地男子被捕，人員在其手提行李發現懷疑大麻花及其他物品。
body: 香港海關周一在香港國際機場拘捕一名56歲內地男旅客，檢獲約3公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約60萬元。
該男子由曼谷抵港。清關時，人員在其手提行李內發現懷疑大麻花、一件含有懷疑第1部毒藥的產品，以及7支未完稅香煙。
案件仍在調查。海關提醒市民，販毒最高可被罰款500萬元及終身監禁。
